create.scopeAll: Every store that keeps stock here
create.scopeHelp: Counting one store at a time keeps the sheet short, and a warehouse with more than {max} items has to be counted that way.

apply.title: Apply count {number}?
apply.description: The difference of each counted line against the snapshot is added to or taken out of the stock of {warehouse}. Sales and transfers made while counting are not touched. Lines that were not counted stay as they are. This cannot be undone.

cancel.title: Cancel count {number}?
cancel.description: The quantities counted so far are thrown away and the stock is not changed. The count cannot be opened again; make a new one.
cancel.descriptionDraft: The draft is discarded. Nothing was counted and the stock is not changed.

sheet.label: Count sheet
sheet.noLines: There are no lines to show.
sheet.showMore: {count, plural, one {Show # more line} other {Show # more lines}}
sheet.missingItem: An item on the shelf that is not on the sheet has no stock in this warehouse yet: receive it with a stock adjustment and make a new count.

save.offline: {count, plural, one {# line is waiting for a signal; it is kept on this phone} other {# lines are waiting for a signal; they are kept on this phone}}
save.refused: The quantities could not be saved.
save.notSent: Some quantities are not saved yet, so the count was not sent. Wait for the signal and try again.

review.label: Review of the count
review.snapshotNote: The difference is counted minus what the warehouse held when the count started. Applying it adds or takes out only that difference: sales and transfers made while counting are not touched.
review.appliedNote: This is what the count applied: only the difference against the snapshot. Sales and transfers made while counting were not touched.
review.uncountedNote: {count, plural, one {# line was not counted and stays as it is.} other {# lines were not counted and stay as they are.}}
review.noVariance: No counted line differs from the snapshot.
review.applyWho: Applying needs the permission to apply counts in every store that has a line with a difference. Whoever lacks it in one of them cannot close a count that includes it.

refusal.shortTitle: Not applied: some lines would go below zero
refusal.refusedTitle: Not applied: some lines cannot be applied
refusal.shortBody: Sales or transfers during the count took stock that the difference would take again. Nothing was applied. Send the count back to counting to recount these lines.
refusal.refusedBody: These lines cannot be changed from the count (a product no longer tracked, or a warehouse switched off or unlinked since the count started). Nothing was applied. Cancel the count and make a new one.
refusal.shortLine: the difference takes out {requested}, the warehouse holds {onHand}

stock.emptyLow: No product is at its alert threshold.
stock.failed: The stock could not be loaded.
stock.refreshFailed: The stock could not be refreshed. What is shown may be out of date.

detail.fileGone: The file is no longer available.

import.description: Paste or upload the file a carrier sends with its settlement, say which column is which, check what is read, and make a draft.
